subject: math
description: Determine whether SSA information creates zero, one, or two possible triangles by using the height test and angle-side evidence.
learningObjectives: Recognize SSA information in an oblique triangle
Use the height from the known angle to decide how many triangles are possible
Distinguish zero-triangle, one-triangle, and two-triangle SSA cases
Explain an ambiguous-case decision using side and angle evidence
Check whether a Law of Sines result gives a valid second angle
